No front door

Followers stay followers

A business owner can watch your content for a year and never join your list. Every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Applications start cold

The jump from a reel to a $50k application is a big one. A class lets owners feel your coaching first, so the ones who apply already believe it.

Stage treadmill

7,976 posts and counting

Demand still leans on the next post, the next episode and the next stage. When you step off for a week, so does the flow of new conversations.

Your events fill a room once. A class fills a room every single day, while you're coaching, speaking or at home.

Fixes the missing front door

One free class becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every sign-up is an email you own, and every owner hears how you coach before you ask for anything.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites owners who want a seat at The Big Table to apply. You only talk to people who watched, stayed and told you where their business is.

Puts your book to work

A Flip the Switch kit is offered at the exact moment owners are most fired up, on the thank-you page, and every buyer lands on your list instead of a retailer's. It helps pay for the ads.

The 95%*

Not ready for $50k yet

They join the free class, grab the Activation Kit on the thank-you page, and keep learning from your emails and podcast. They pay you while they grow into the next step.

The qualified 5%

Ready for a seat at the table

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for revenue and readiness before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"It's not a strategy problem"

Hook
"If you know exactly what to do and you're still not doing it, this is for you." (to camera, leather chair, the same look as your profile)
Body
"Most owners I meet don't need another strategy. They've got a notebook full of them. What's missing is drive: the switch that turns knowing into doing, every single day. Once it's on, everything else gets easier." (bold on-screen captions)
CTA
"I'm teaching exactly how to flip it in a free 60-minute class called Flip the Switch Live. Tap Sign up to save your seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions for owners who feel stuck"

Hook
"Feel stuck at the same number? Answer these three questions." (Coach Burt holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: what are you chasing, specifically? Two: who's at your table, and are they pulling you up or holding you back? Three: what would you do this week if you knew you couldn't fail? Your answers tell you which level of drive you're running at." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go deep on all three in my free masterclass. Link below."
